title: Extreme RAG: EvidenceSuite -> Lexical -> KG
description: Enterprise-grade RAG refinement focusing on: (1) EvidenceSuite Workbench (persistent ground-truth evidence assets + approvals), (2) lexical fallback recall hardening (zh/codes/paths), (3) KG-assisted retrieval integration and metrics.

title: EvidenceSuite workbench: CRUD + approvals + sync to regression
description: Add server-side EvidenceSuite/EvidenceItem persistence with status flow (draft->reviewed->approved->archived), dataset-scoped UI workbench, and one-click sync/upsert of approved items into RAGAS regression cases for retrieval-only evaluation.
acceptance_criteria:
- EvidenceSuite + EvidenceItem tables exist and are tenant+dataset scoped
- APIs exist for suite/item CRUD + review/approve/archive
- UI under /datasets/[id]/evidence supports creating suites, creating items via retrieval preview or evidence pack import, selecting citations as reference_sources, status transitions, export, and sync to regression cases
- web api coverage/contract checks pass
- lint/typecheck/tests pass
notes:
Implemented backend EvidenceSuite/EvidenceItem persistence + CRUD/approval/export/sync APIs; wired v1 router + model registration; added web api-client coverage + TS types; regenerated OpenAPI types. (commit 59adbc5)
Added dataset-scoped Evidence Workbench UI at /datasets/[id]/evidence: suite list + item list/detail, create suite, create item via retrieve or evidence pack import, status transitions (review/approve/archive), export suite + sync to regression; added datasets page nav entry. (pending: item edit + suite archive UI polish)

title: Lexical fallback excellence: zh/codes/paths + indexes + metrics

acceptance_criteria:
- Lexical DB retrieval has explicit per-query debug/attribution metrics
- Index guidance/migrations exist for FTS + trigram (best-effort)
- zh/code/path queries show improved recall in regression suite
- tests/lint pass
notes: Added per-query retrieval channel metrics (vector/BM25/lexical DB candidates + attribution + diversity deltas) to retriever_debug and surfaced in evidence query_debug; added lexical fallback ops guide; extended retrieval SLO gate with path query. (commit 1d8ad1f)

title: KG-assisted retrieval: dataset scope + query expansion channel + metrics
description: Integrate KG into retrieval: dataset-scoped KG search/recall, entity/alias expansion feeding retriever, and metrics showing KG contribution to recall.
acceptance_criteria:
- KG search supports dataset_id scope (no required document_ids for common workflows)
- Retrieval pipeline can optionally add KG-based expansions/candidates with clear attribution
- Evaluation reports can slice/show KG contribution
- tests/lint pass

title: Query expansion for recall (aliases/synonyms + multi-query presets)

Log expansions in retrieval trace and evaluate via retrieval-only regression gate (Hit@20/MRR/NDCG@20).
